description: Write and send a new message from an account.

identity.goal: Complete the send message use case of mailcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the mailcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `mailcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced mailcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `mailcraft_list_contacts`, `mailcraft_send_message`. Steps: (1) Look up the recipient among the contacts. (2) Write and send the message. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace mailcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
